text:
mara: Heads-up — we're getting repeated tickets where apps hit limits and the SDK error is just 'quota_exceeded'. No Retry-After, no scope, nothing. Customers keep asking how long to wait or whether to fallback. Can we agree on a standard shape?

pjensen: Yeah saw that. For HTTP 429 we should include `Retry-After` header (seconds) + a JSON body with `scope` (org/key), `remaining` (tokens), and `quota_type` (burst/steady).

sam: +1. Also include a machine-friendly `reason_code` so SDKs can map to behaviors (e.g., 'org_rate_limit', 'api_key_limit', 'burst_window').

lina: Quick UX point — console should show the same human-readable message and the breakdown (org vs key) in the usage dashboard and the route details page. If backend returns scope=org, highlight which route(s) triggered it.

mara: Draft error body proposal (for docs & SDKs):

```json
{
  \"error\": {
    \"message\": \"Rate limit exceeded\",
    \"reason_code\": \"org_rate_limit\",
    \"scope\": \"org\",
    \"quota_type\": \"burst\",
    \"retry_after_secs\": 30,
    \"details\": {
      \"org_limit\": 1200,
      \"org_remaining\": 0,
      \"key_limit\": 600,
      \"key_remaining\": 50
    }
  }
}
```

pjensen: That looks good. One ask: make `retry_after_secs` optional — if we don't have an exact time (e.g., soft throttling), we should provide `recommended_backoff`: [1,2,4] so SDKs can do exponential.

sam: Agree. Also include an `action` hint for UI — values like `show_quota_upgrade_cta`, `suggest_backoff`, `fallback_to_cached` so console and SDKs can present guidance.

lina: For console copy: short line + CTA. e.g., "Request rate limit reached for your organization. To restore throughput, upgrade reserved capacity or retry after 30s. [View usage] [Request increase]" Keep it non-technical.

mara: Implementation notes: routing layer must attach `quota_type` and `scope` at enforcement time. Can we get ops to add those fields to the enforcement event? cc @ops-bot

ops-bot: enforcement-event-12345 logged — fields added: scope=org, quota_type=burst, route_id=gen-embed-1, window_ms=60000, consumed=1200.

pjensen: Great. Next: SDK mapping. Proposal: SDK error object: `{ code, message, reason_code, retry_after_secs, recommended_backoff, meta }`. Meta contains raw details. We should ship helpers: isRetryable(err), suggestedDelay(err).

sam: Devex: we need a short FAQ update and an error-handling guide snippet. I'll draft a copy and tests for JS/py SDKs. Include examples for immediate fallback vs soft throttle.

lina: Also telemetry: tag errors with `reason_code` and `scope` so we can measure how many org vs key limits occur. Add an alert when org_rate_limit > 0.5% of requests for an org over 5m window.

mara: Rollout plan: server returns new shape but keep backwards-compatible `message` and `code`. SDKs read new fields if present. Docs and console updated in same release. Can we target next deploy window (Thu)?

pjensen: Fine with Thu if infra has the enforcement event change live. I'll coordinate with eng-infra.

sam: I'll open a docs PR with examples and add a short snippet in the console's usage modal explaining 'burst vs steady' quotas.

lina: Could we also add a small toast in Console when a user hits an org limit: "You're hitting org rate limits — some requests may be delayed. View details." Link to route-level traces.

mara: Perfect. Last question: internationalization of messages? We should keep machine fields constant but translate the `message` shown to users in console.

sam: Yep, i18n for console copy handled in product files. SDKs always show the machine message unless app overrides it.

mara: Thanks all — I'll consolidate this thread into an RFC draft (short) and link it to the SDK issues. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Created issue DE-1123: "Standardize rate-limit error shape + console UX" and assigned to mara, sam, pjensen.

pjensen: Leaving a small checklist: enforcement events emitted (ops), server response fields (eng-runtime), SDK helpers + tests (devex), console copy + toast (product, devex), docs PR (sam).

lina: I'll file the console task and attach mockups.

mara: Cool — closing loop here. If anyone sees support tickets over the next 24h, tag this issue.
